paper_anchor: Proposition 6.3, Equations (25)-(26); Appendix G.3, Proposition G.4, Equations (209)-(217)
statement: The reparameterized JKO update is a first-order implicit discretization of the G(theta)^-1-preconditioned parameter flow.
assumptions: theta to F_theta is Frechet differentiable into L2(mu)
partial_theta F_theta is square integrable in a neighborhood
theta to the energy of mu_theta is differentiable
G is invertible for the preconditioned-flow interpretation

quantifiers.updates: each exact minimizer satisfying the assumptions

acceptance: the general Frechet-remainder derivation is machine audited
a nonlinear continuous family with positive-definite off-diagonal G exhibits first-order residual convergence
the preconditioned velocity convergence is first order
replacing G by I leaves a nonvanishing residual and exits 1
